name: Arabic Quality Share-Alike Composite Textpack
description: Generated source-backed Arabic quality recipe composite over the policy-expanded Arabic MSA component graph, including share-alike isolated syntax evidence.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated share-alike recipe composite over publishable Arabic core, normalization, segmentation, lexicon, morphology, syntax, search, KB, corpus, and parallel components, with required component reports and evaluation evidence for the full policy-expanded Arabic MSA graph. Required KB, corpus, and parallel components provide local task-usable payloads for their declared scopes, and quality components aggregate generated quality reports and evaluation evidence over those materialized payloads.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: Required component source rows are approved and either default-compatible, attribution-compatible, or share-alike isolated. The UD Arabic NYUAD component remains isolated behind the required -sa package policy surface.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Arabic MSA share-alike resource-quality component composite for the generated policy-expanded Arabic graph. It does not claim dialect quality diagnostics, Classical/Quranic coverage, OPUS coverage, corpus-scale quality baselines, readability scoring, OCR/noisy-text diagnostics, annotation adjudication, or permissive default-package compatibility.
